note: The recipe library for the public site (page-platform S9) — human-authored, brand-owned, named behaviours referencing the instance's motion tokens; played by the open Web Animations API and CSS. The six estate recipes come from sturij-core-editor src/motion/recipes.json verbatim; the page's own recipes come from the handoff README (Interactions & Behaviour). Reduced motion is a licensed variation: each recipe declares its mapping — fade (opacity only), instant (jump to the end), none (static). The page reads prefers-reduced-motion once and applies the mapping (components/motion.ts).

recipes.description: Arrives from one step below, fading in; rests where it is locked.
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the framework's motion family, 3 Sep 2026)

recipes.description: Arrives from the rail's edge — a drawer or a strip opening; rests where it is locked.
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the framework's motion family, 3 Sep 2026)

recipes.description: Lifts one step while hovered or dragged; returns to rest after.
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the framework's motion family, 3 Sep 2026)

recipes.description: Arrives from half a step above and settles into its lock.
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the framework's motion family, 3 Sep 2026)

recipes.description: Arrives from one step below when scrolled into view (the handoff: IntersectionObserver at .18, 26px, 900ms ease-out).
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the framework's motion family, 3 Sep 2026)

recipes.description: Crossfades one state to the next in place; ends at rest (the gallery crossfade, 200ms).
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the framework's motion family, 3 Sep 2026)

recipes.description: The caption handover between sticky panels: the outgoing caption fades over t 0→.45, the incoming stays hidden until .72 and is in at 1; one opacity per caption per frame, the smaller of the two (README §2, §8).
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the public site handoff, 9 Sep 2026)

recipes.description: As the next panel travels up, the current panel darkens to 45% and zooms to 1.06 while the incoming panel fades in over the first 40% — scroll-scrubbed, rAF-lerp smoothed at the instance's lerp factor (README §2).
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the public site handoff, 9 Sep 2026)

recipes.description: A gallery ribbon scrolling by half its own width in a linear loop (60s main, 34–58s minis); the main pauses on hover (README §3).
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the public site handoff, 9 Sep 2026)

recipes.description: The gold thumb slides to the active tab (450ms, the settle curve) (README §3).
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the public site handoff, 9 Sep 2026)

recipes.description: The stacking cards pin 28px below the sticky header, stepped 18px per card with heights reduced so every bottom edge aligns; the pile releases together when the next section covers it (README §8).
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the public site handoff, 9 Sep 2026)

recipes.description: Mosaic tiles reveal their slice of the photograph in a random order proportional to scroll progress; each tile fades and settles from a 1.14 scale (README §9).
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the public site handoff, 9 Sep 2026)

recipes.description: A generated visual arrives blurred at 30% under the gold spinner and is revealed on View over 600–700ms (README §6).
recipes.author: Mark Walton (the public site handoff, 9 Sep 2026)
